correctness.rationale: Uniform mapping enumeration gives \(\Pr(K=k)=k(n)_k/n^{k+1}\) and a Rayleigh core. Conditional independent uniformly located cyclic sets give, by explicit collision estimates, the full mixed-factorial-moment convergence for every fixed number of maps. Conditional joint Poisson convergence and random-size mixing then prove the weak limit; a two-dimensional Rayleigh integral equals 1/3. Exact rational verification checked all small maps through n=5 (102 assertion groups). The proof does not mistake finite checks for infinite verification.

value.rationale: The intersection of the recurrent cores of two independent finite dynamical systems is a natural synchronization statistic: although each occupies only order sqrt(n) among n labels, their shared count has a nontrivial mixed-Poisson limit. The exact 2/3 chance of at least one common periodic state is a precise new invariant, and the fixed-family dependence array distinguishes positive covariances along pairs sharing a map from exact independence along disjoint pairs. This is a structural classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
